sentences.text: In short: NORRØNA AS is an established company in "utleie av egen eller leid fast eiendom" based in Kristiansand, loss-making in 2025.

NORRØNA AS is registered in the industry "Utleie av egen eller leid fast eiendom"; its registered activity is "Kjøp, drift og utleie av eiendommer til bruk for Norsk Luthersk Misjonssambands ideelle virksomhet i Region Sør i Norge.".
NORRØNA AS is a private limited company (AS), founded on 1966-03-30, registered in Kristiansand.
It reported revenue of NOK 1.35M for 2025 and an operating loss of NOK 254,397 (2025).
Its 2025 accounts show an operating margin of -18.8% and a strong equity ratio of 78% of total assets.

Revenue rose 4.8% from 2024 to 2025 (NOK 1.29M to NOK 1.35M); it was NOK 1.58M in 2023. The annual result was a loss in each of the 3 filed years read (2023: -NOK 967,685, 2024: -NOK 530,465, 2025: -NOK 339,685).
NORRØNA AS is led by board chair Rune Myra.
It has a board of 4. The register last recorded a change to its roles on 2026-04-17 (within the past year).
